records.reason: No complete Spotify edition of the SPA4034 programme was verified. Same-choir Kyriale releases omit the original LP rear-side ancient litanies, so they are partial programmes rather than this album. The similarly titled World of Gregorian Chant has John McCarthy and the Carmelite Priory choir, a different performance.

records.spineText: SQN 7765 · JULIAN BREAM PLAYS BACH & VILLA LOBOS · Julian Bream, guitar
records.reason: The exact Sine Qua Non SQN7765 Bach/Villa-Lobos compilation was not verified on Spotify. The LP rear identifies Bream’s 1956 Vienna sessions. Spotify carries the early Bach recital separately, but it lacks the five Villa-Lobos preludes; modern RCA and broad Bream anthologies are different packages and may contain later performances.

records.title: The Polka Dot Pony
records.spineText: THE POLKA DOT PONY · FRED PENNER · TROUBADOUR RECORDS
records.reason: Poco is a documented retitle of The Polka Dot Pony, but the current Spotify versions contain substantial duration/version changes in three songs. The original 1981 LP and 1991 OSCD034 rear list Cat Came Back (Again)2:52, Piggyback Ride0:59 and Julie Gerond7:40; Spotify has3:34,1:13 and8:18. Identical song order alone does not prove those are the original recordings. No closer complete Spotify edition was verified.
